notes: Also marketed as "BirdDog Eyes P200" (SKU BDP200B black / BDP200W white). Rear-panel port list and labels taken verbatim from BirdDog's official P200 User Guide (NDI 5, 2022), "Camera Connections" diagram, page 11, cross-checked against the manufacturer techspecs page (birddog.tv/p200-overview/p200-techspecs/) and B&H/retailer listings. The RS232 and RS-422 ports are both physically RJ45 jacks (adaptor cables to RS232 DB9 / RS422 terminal are included in box); the manual states the RS-422 port also carries RS485 (Pelco P/D) on the same RJ45, so it is modeled as one bidirectional control port. The network RJ45 carries NDI video/audio/control plus VISCA-over-IP and PoE+ (IEEE 802.3at) power-in; graded eth-1g since NDI over PTZ cameras of this era is specified for Gigabit Ethernet (manual: "existing Gigabit Ethernet network"). CVBS and 3G-SDI outputs are shown in the manual's rear-panel diagram as identical circular BNC-style jacks; CVBS connector type is inferred from the diagram (not an explicit text label) so treated as medium-confidence for that one port. HDMI explicitly specified as HDMI 1.4 in the manual. USB 2.0 port is firmware-upgrade only; manual diagram shows a small rectangular port consistent with USB Micro-B but exact sub-type is not labeled in text (low certainty on connector sub-type only, modeled as usb-micro / usb-2.0). This is a desktop/ceiling/wall-mount PTZ camera, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. "Camera" is not in the provided type enum, so type is omitted; category set to "source" (media/video source device) as the closest fit.
